summary: Suzano S.A. files a Form 6-K (material fact) reporting that antitrust approvals have been obtained for its acquisition of a 51% equity interest in a new Dutch company from Kimberly-Clark Corporation (K-C). Under the Equity and Asset Purchase Agreement, Suzano International Holding B.V. (purchaser) will acquire 51%, while K-C retains 49% of the target which holds tissue product assets in South/Central America, Europe, Africa, the Middle East, Asia, and Oceania. Closing requires completion of K-C's corporate reorganization in the included regions and is expected in Q3 2026. No price/share, premium, or advisor named. Watch for reorganization completion and regulatory timeline.
